# Named static ancestors and original defaults

The recursive Enum default fixture gains a nongeneric static nested class
inside a generic enclosing owner. The receiver extends that plain ancestor,
which has its own constructor, mutable state and a final getter. The source and
unchanged ancestor-JAR profiles retain its independent scope, original default
ownership, all metadata and method inventory, and zero bridges or projections.

The immutable JVM harness keeps the original 24 value cases, 375 identities,
125 state observations and ten ordered failures, then checks ancestor
initialization, mutable aliases, virtual override effects and reflected failure
identity. The existing same-Code generic scope counterexamples and independent
javac override checks remain active. Native tests also cover Signature-free
receivers, alpha-equivalent method-owned defaults, captured or unknown scopes,
and same-erasure parameter, result and formal-count drift.
